title: Altadena Community Meeting - November 10, 2025
description:
Altadena Community Meeting - November 10, 2025 - Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors Chair Kathryn Barger will host an Altadena Community Meeting for residents impacted by the Eaton Fire.

Watch the meeting live on the County's YouTube page. Missed the last meeting? All previous Altadena Community Meetings are available to watch on the County's YouTube page.

For more information, FAQs, and resources, visit recovery.lacounty.gov/Altadena
